name: Crown Packaging Corp. - Salt Lake City, Utah Office
old_description: Since 1969, we’ve been recognized as a leading packaging company.  We’ve continued to expand with an international network of dedicated specialists, warehouses, and service technicians across the US, Mexico, and Canada.
about:
Crown Packaging Corp. operates a branch office in Salt Lake City, Utah, at 1845 West 1040 South, Suite 14. The company traces its origins to 1969 when it was established as a packaging supplier; the Salt Lake City location serves as a regional hub for the broader organization that now spans the United States, Mexico, and Canada. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The branch functions as a full-line distributor of packaging materials and equipment, offering more than 125,000 stock items sourced from manufacturers. Its product range includes corrugated boxes, polyethylene and polypropylene bags, stretch and shrink films, tapes, labels, void-fill systems, and strapping. Beyond supply, the location provides warehousing and vendor-managed inventory programs, custom printing on boxes, labels, films, bags, tape, and strapping, and a dedicated equipment division that handles consultation, installation, and maintenance for case sealers, stretch wrappers, case formers, and strapping machines.

The Utah branch supports businesses across the Intermountain West, with explicit experience in medical and pharmaceutical packaging as well as general industrial, e-commerce, and cold-chain applications. Customers range from small operations to large enterprises seeking single-source procurement and supply-chain streamlining.

Crown emphasizes its regional warehousing network, vendor-managed inventory model, and specialization in cold-chain, corrugated, and automation solutions as key differentiators. The company positions its local specialists as on-site resources for troubleshooting and continuous improvement of packaging lines.

name: Cummins Inc.
old_description: Cummins Inc. is a global power solutions company that, among other products, offers transfer switches and switchgear for generator power systems. Equipment is used in construction, industrial and backup power applications.
about:
Cummins Inc. was founded in 1919 in Columbus, Indiana. The company grew from a small engine manufacturer into a global power solutions provider and is now publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CMI).

Today Cummins designs and manufactures diesel, natural gas, and alternative-fuel engines, fully integrated generator sets, transfer switches, switchgear, and a range of components including emission solutions, automated transmissions, and drivetrain systems. Its Accelera brand delivers zero-emission power systems, while the company's global network comprises more than 9,000 service locations. Headcount at the Columbus headquarters is reported as 1,000-plus employees.

The company serves construction, power generation, marine, industrial, and mining sectors. Concrete examples include powering Digital Realty data centers, supporting Polish rail modernization projects, and developing hybrid diesel-battery mining trucks. Cummins also supplies public transit agencies and has marked 100 years of service to the global mining industry.

Cummins differentiates itself through its "Power Onward" strategy, which spans diesel, natural gas, hybrid, electric, and biofuel technologies, and its "Destination Zero" pledge to reduce emissions across the product lifecycle. The firm emphasizes integrated power solutions backed by deep technical expertise and a worldwide support footprint.

name: Curd Enterprises Inc. / Multiplastics & Curd Buoys
old_description: Curd Enterprises, Inc., dba CURD BUOYS, has been manufacturing buoys for the marine industry since 1970.  Being based in beautiful, historic Charleston, South Carolina has afforded us ample opportunity to test each of our models in a coastal setting for ruggedness, visibility, and durability, ensuring exceptional products for over 40 years.
about:
Curd Enterprises, Inc., doing business as Curd Buoys, was founded in 1970 in Mt Pleasant, South Carolina. The woman-owned small business began producing buoys for the marine industry, leveraging its coastal location near historic Charleston to test each model in real-world conditions for ruggedness, visibility, and durability.

The company manufactures a range of marine navigation aids including buoys, floats, lights, hardware, decals, and Aids to Navigation (ATON) equipment. Products are evaluated in coastal environments to ensure they withstand harsh marine exposure. No specific facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed publicly.

Curd Buoys serves the marine industry, maritime navigation authorities, and federal government agencies. As a GSA Schedule contract holder (GS-07F-0268N), the company supplies navigational aids to federal buyers. Its customer base includes port authorities, marine contractors, and government entities requiring compliant ATON equipment.

The company emphasizes its decades of experience and real-world testing in Charleston waters as key differentiators. It backs products with a 12-month replacement warranty against faulty workmanship and materials, and maintains SBA certification as a Woman-Owned Small Business, supporting its eligibility for federal set-aside contracts.

name: Custom Built Cabinetry
old_description: We are a family run cabinet shop servicing Oahu since 1991. We are proud to say that we get the job done every single time, no exceptions. Our style is based on traditional Hawaiian plantation with a classy modern functionality….
about:
Founded in 1991 in Kailua, on the island of Oahu, Custom Built Cabinetry operates as a family-run cabinet shop. The business was established to serve residential clients across Oahu with custom woodwork rooted in the islands' plantation heritage.

The shop handles the full cycle of custom cabinetry: design, fabrication, and installation. Projects range from kitchen cabinets and bath vanities to closet systems and entertainment centers. All casework is built from domestic Maple plywood treated for termite resistance, with Blum soft-close hardware on doors and drawers; particle board is not used.

Custom Built Cabinetry serves homeowners, condo owners, and renovation contractors on Oahu. Recent projects include a Hawaii Kai condo renovation encompassing kitchen, master and secondary baths, and an entertainment center, as well as numerous kitchen remodels for private residences.

The company emphasizes its 30 years of design experience and a style that blends traditional Hawaiian plantation aesthetics with modern functionality. It cites its material choices — termite-treated Maple ply and premium hardware — and a reputation for exceeding expectations as key differentiators.

name: Custom Sheet Metal of Delaware INC.
old_description: Based in Newport, Delaware, Custom Sheet Metal of Delaware, Inc. is a locally owned and operated custom fabrication shop. We have over 90 years of combined experience in the industry of creating custom metal work that is beautiful, functional, and of the highest quality.
about:
Custom Sheet Metal of Delaware, Inc. operates from Newport, Delaware, where it was founded in 1984 by Bill Wilson. Wilson began working in sheet metal at age 17, building a one-man enterprise that eventually outgrew smaller facilities and relocated to the current site. The company remains family-owned, now led by Wilson's grandson Buddy Johnson as president, with his daughter Terry Johnson as office manager and Ron Faulkner as vice president and shop foreman.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication across industrial, commercial, and residential sectors. Its capabilities include shearing, braking, punching, welding, soldering, polishing, finishing, manual lathe turning, and bending, supplemented by CNC plasma cutting, laser cutting, waterjet cutting, and small-part powder coating. Equipment includes CNC press brakes, plasma systems, laser cutters, and waterjet machines, enabling work in steel, stainless steel, copper, and aluminum. The company handles projects ranging from single custom parts to runs of a thousand pieces.

Customers span industrial, commercial, and residential markets. Commercial clients receive precision shearing, laser, plasma, and waterjet cutting for project-specific requirements. Residential work covers similar cutting techniques for steel, stainless steel, copper, and aluminum. Industrial projects leverage the same advanced cutting technologies for precision and efficiency. The firm notes it has worked with hundreds of local companies.

The company emphasizes its legacy of excellence and modern equipment as differentiators. It states that no job is too big or too small, and that its cutting-edge machinery allows it to meet modern demands from concept to final product. The 90 years of combined team experience and family-run continuity are presented as foundations for quality and service.

name: D & R Products | Medical Device Outsource Manufacturer
old_description: D&R Products is an expert contract manufacturer of medical devices offering exceptional in-house manufacturing from bar stock to finished device. Driven by quality and service, we create collaborative partnerships with OEMs and their engineers. With over 80 years of continuous American manufacturing, 38 years focused on contract manufacturing for medical devices, D&R has the experience and know-how to get your job done right.
about:
D&R Products operates from a 43,000-square-foot facility in Hudson, Massachusetts. The company traces its roots to 1938, marking over 80 years of continuous American manufacturing, with the last 38 years dedicated specifically to contract manufacturing for medical devices.

As a contract manufacturer, D&R provides turnkey, in-house production from bar stock to finished device. Capabilities span CNC Swiss and American-style turning, wire EDM, precision grinding on four Rollamatic grinders with robotic feeding and lights-out operation, secondary finishing (deburring, polishing, tumbling, electropolishing, passivation, laser marking), clean room assembly and packaging in ISO Class 7 and Class 8 environments, and welding (laser, palm arc, resistance). The shop works with exotic alloys such as nitinol, titanium, PEEK, and Radel, and has developed proprietary machining methods for nitinol. Annual output ranges from small lots to millions of pieces, with tens of thousands of projects completed and millions of products shipped.

The customer base consists of medical device OEMs, including six of the seven largest companies in the sector, and the firm serves as a sole-source supplier for more than 75 percent of its product lines. Typical components include nitinol-based implants, minimally invasive surgical instruments, arthroscopic shaver blades and burrs, RF electrodes, soft tissue refixation implants, and specialty needles, cannulas, and trocars.

D&R emphasizes keeping critical processes under one roof to shorten throughput, maintain traceability to raw bar stock, and control quality through its ISO 13485:2016 system. Customers work directly with the executive team and engineers without middle management, enabling custom process development, fixture and tooling design, reverse engineering, and Cpk analysis tailored to each project.

about:
D F Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1974 in Cincinnati, Ohio, to serve regional original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the central Ohio River area with design and engineering services that lead to the manufacturing of electronics assemblies.

The company produces electronics assemblies in volumes ranging from a few hundred to tens of thousands per year, integrating manufacturing engineering into new designs from the prototype stage. Manufacturing is performed on a turn‑key basis with full testing, including in‑circuit testing using Gen‑Rad equipment. DF Electronics also assumes responsibility for basic sustaining engineering, maintains full documentation and written procedures aligned with FDA and ISO quality guidelines, and offers manufacturing engineering services to improve cost effectiveness and add functionality. The firm works within customers’ MRP, JIT, and Kanban systems to provide flexible scheduling and shipping from its centrally located Cincinnati facility.

DF Electronics serves OEM customers across the region, though the input does not specify particular industry verticals beyond general electronics assembly.

The company emphasizes its ability to incorporate manufacturing engineering early in the design process and its commitment to fast resolution of open issues as key differentiators.
